children: Wonder, a food-delivery startup led by former Walmart executive Marc Lore, is exploring a sale of delivery company Grubhub, The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Bankers have been in contact with Walmart, Target, Kroger, and other retailers about a potential acquisition, the report added.
